metadata.dataset: NASA Space Technology Taxonomy & Technology Readiness Levels (TRL)
metadata.source: NASA Office of the Chief Technologist (OCT)

technologies.name: High-Mast Polar Solar (VSAT)
technologies.description: Telescoping 10m mast solar arrays engineered for low grazing sun elevation over polar crater rims.

technologies.name: Volatile Prospecting Autonomous Rovers
technologies.description: Neutron spectrometer and drill-equipped rover chassis capable of traversing cryogenic 40K shadowed terrain.

technologies.name: Inflatable Multi-Layer Habitats
technologies.description: Deployable Kevlar/Nextel inflatable pressure vessels with integrated micrometeorite and radiation protection.

technologies.name: Cryogenic Sublimation Ice Excavation
technologies.description: Thermal coring drills and vapor condensation domes to extract water from rock-hard polar regolith.

technologies.name: Microwave Regolith 3D Sintering
technologies.description: Electromagnetic sintering of lunar basalt into durable blast pads and radiation berms.

technologies.name: Molten Regolith Electrolysis (MRE)
technologies.description: Thermal decomposition of mineral oxides at 1600°C for infinite oxygen and metal construction feedstock.

technologies.name: Fission Surface Power (Kilopower KRUSTY)
technologies.description: U-235 cast core with Stirling convertors delivering continuous multi-kilowatt power through 14-day nights.

technologies.name: Zero-Boil-Off Cryogenic Propellant Depot
technologies.description: Active pulse-tube cryocooling and sunshields for permanent liquid hydrogen/methane/oxygen space storage.
